responsibility: Supplies shared IPA utility routines for callgraph traversal, SCC discovery, ordering, and profile handling. It implements reduced postorder and cycle bookkeeping, prints callgraph orders for debugging, and provides common helpers such as recursive-call tests and profile-merging support used by multiple IPA passes.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the actual implementations of the shared utilities declared in ipa-utils.h, notably callgraph DFS/SCC ordering, profile-merging, and recursion helpers, whereas the header serves as the broader declaration umbrella for these and many other cross-IPA utility interfaces.
